column1: # The function resolve (P/06.7 Н1.14, Н3 resolve, Н5 resolve): resolve(field, unit, domain) → {value, from} | {groups, from}.
# input — the input of the command resolve as JSON text: field — {name, type, inherit?, merge?, document?, group_by?}, unit — the value of the row
# of the unit (no key — no value), domain — {term, rev, value} of the value in the document or null. expect — a subset of the output or «@exit 2» (the input is out of form).
# The rows — the acceptance inputs of М11/11 inputs/resolve-*.json, sc. 03 (taken over by the move of lesson 10).

column4: a field without inherit, not document and not group_by — out of the form of the common section of P/02.1 (Н3 resolve pre; C06-RESOLVE-ABSENT-INHERIT-91-01)
union: an element of the list is not a string — out of form (type list; Н5 exit; C06-RESOLVE-UNION-FORM-01)
rev greater than 2^53 − 1 — out of form (Н5 exit; C06-RESOLVE-UNION-FORM-01)
